rules.label: Statistics: dated points at least
rules.whose: Owner, October 2: "you have to bring in their statistics"; two points show rising, stable or falling
rules.note: Launchroom checks this on every card (os/src/researchView.mjs STATS_MIN_POINTS); ask the OS builder before changing it.

rules.label: Statistics: rising or falling beyond
rules.unit: percent between the oldest and newest point
rules.whose: Launchroom's own rule (ours), not from the research
rules.note: Inside the band the trend reads as stable. Checked in code (TREND_BAND_PERCENT); ask the OS builder before changing it.

rules.label: Angles and avatars to target
rules.whose: Owner, October 2: "various different angles and avatars to target"
rules.note: The main audience plus two others (AVATARS_MINIMUM in code).

rules.label: Dropshippable: heavier than this fails
rules.whose: Owner, October 2: heavy or bulky items (over about 2 lb or oversized) fail F2

rules.label: First test loss limit
rules.whose: Owner, October 2 (memory/JOURNAL.md)
rules.note: The most the first test may spend before we decide. It buys a signal, not a verdict.

rules.label: Concepts per test
rules.whose: Gemini (Dara Denney), research A and C: 3-5 distinct concepts
rules.note: Start at the low end when the loss limit is small.

rules.label: Formats per concept
rules.whose: Gemini: ad families, 3-5 concepts x 2-3 formats

rules.label: No edits after launch
rules.whose: Gemini (72-120 h), Adenslab in research C (72 h)

rules.label: Target cost per sale
rules.whose: Gemini (Baker): target cost per sale at or below about 55% of bundle order value
rules.note: Use the lower of this and break-even.

rules.label: Flag a break-even under
rules.whose: Ours (CHECKS S4): Meta sales in home categories often cost $20-75; Adenslab in research C: $25-50

rules.label: Kill an ad
rules.unit: x target cost per sale spent, no sale
rules.whose: Owner, October 2: the patient kill line (Coinis in research A; Gemini says 2x)
rules.note: "Probably have to be more patient due to the algorithm."

rules.label: Trim: spend reached
rules.whose: Gemini

rules.label: Trim: cost per sale over
rules.whose: Gemini

rules.label: Trim: extra time before deciding
rules.whose: Gemini: 24-48 h

rules.label: Kill a concept when this many of its ads hit the kill line
rules.whose: Gemini: 2 of 4 ads

rules.label: Scale: holds the target for
rules.whose: Gemini

rules.label: Scale: budget step, at most
rules.whose: Gemini, Adenslab and RoasPig in research C; Meta's learning resets above about 20-25% (second-hand)

rules.label: Scale: at most once every
rules.whose: Gemini: 24-48 h; Adenslab: 2-3 days

rules.label: Early signals: judge after
rules.whose: RoasPig in research C
rules.note: A small budget is judged by early signals (owner, October 2).

rules.label: Early signals: weak click rate under
rules.whose: Howland in research B (under 1%); Adenslab average 1.49% in research C
rules.note: Weak click rate points at the picture or hook.

rules.label: Early signals: link clicks with no purchase
rules.whose: RoasPig in research C ($50 spent, 30+ link clicks, no purchase)
rules.note: Points at the page or the offer.

hardLimits.label: Earbuds, headphones and Bluetooth audio
hardLimits.whose: Owner, October 2: "earbuds arent something we can dropship"
